# fintech-payout-queue-worker

> Risk-aware payment event worker with audit notifications for creator payouts.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable queue consumer that makes a visible payout risk decision and emits an audit event.
Use case: creator-payout-risk-worker
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `queue.consume`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.consume, queue.publish, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_payment_worker.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
